answer: Witness-Diverse Work Audit. Each identity’s completed tasks are spot-checked by peers selected from disjoint cohorts, and a zephyr of randomized challenge prompts verifies the claimed work path. Duplicates surface because identical task traces collide under independent checks, like a glacier splitting the same flow. Every new identity must fund fresh cohort diversity and absorb failed-audit penalties, a per-identity pigment cost that rises with clone count.
